findings.title: plan.md Phase 1 missing locking requirement cross-reference for /audit-fix closed.json writes
findings.detail: self-heal-pipeline.md §3 defines a HARD requirement: /audit-fix MUST use mkdir-based locking before reading or writing closed.json (macOS has no flock(1)). Under ≥2 concurrent audit-fix lanes this race is deterministic and causes fingerprint count drift. Phase 1 of plan.md documents the fixed→closed lifecycle but has no cross-reference to this critical constraint, so implementers working from plan.md alone would miss it.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a WARNING block after the status lifecycle table in plan.md Phase 1 pointing to self-heal-pipeline.md §3 locking contract.
